summary: PASS. Verified the react-native-youtube-iframe platform-split fix. App loads (HOME renders with top tabs, no blank screen, no red-box). RECAP → recap-game-mil-uti-17-2 opens highlights-player which on WEB correctly renders the web-watch fallback (thumbnail + 'WATCH ON YOUTUBE'). Score header (Utica City 2 / Wave 17), FROM THE BOOTH commentary from Rayo (Mateo 'Rayo' Reyes) and Casey (Casey Whitfield) all render. Back navigation returns to the RECAP list without crashing. Regression: cold-open-hero triggers the onair-bar and it persists across HOME → STATS → SCORES tab switches. Backend: 28/28 pytest passing on the entire MASL suite (TestTalk excluded intentionally to avoid LLM cost/latency). /api/games returns all 5 games with the expected video_id values (opW7LVDvTkQ, wrvbAD76QdE, -tNpJHj-DWY, X2vnyC1SrSE, tlF8VAlXFyY), each with a label. /api/segments/stats returns 5 beats with no hockey terminology (all 6 segment pages verified: recap=5, tonight=5, home=6, reels=4, scores=5, stats=5).
critical_code_review_comments: Platform-split is correctly implemented: YTPlayer.web.tsx uses only RN + expo-image + Linking (no react-native-web-webview import), so Metro web bundling no longer trips on the unresolved dependency. Native YTPlayer.tsx imports react-native-youtube-iframe only — good.
app/highlights/[id].tsx imports @/src/components/YTPlayer (module-level), so Metro resolves .web.tsx for web and .tsx for native automatically; no dynamic guard needed.

Native containment (staying inside the app instead of launching the YouTube app) requires an on-device build and cannot be validated on the web preview — per the agent-to-agent note, intentionally out of scope.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Highlights player uses a platform-split module. On web, testID='web-watch' is expected; on native, react-native-youtube-iframe renders inside a testID='highlights-player' wrapper. To validate native inline containment (the actual original bug fix), test on iOS/Android or Expo Go — not possible via web preview.
rca_of_issue: N/A — regression re-verified. Fix (platform-split YTPlayer with .web.tsx fallback avoiding react-native-web-webview import) resolves both the web bundling regression and, on native, replaces the raw WebView embed with react-native-youtube-iframe for contained playback.
